summary: Sunlands Technology Group filed a Form 6-K attaching its Q1 2026 earnings press release. Net revenues were RMB440.7M ($63.9M), down 9.6% YoY; net income was RMB76.8M ($11.1M), roughly flat. No M&A, shareholder proposal, or corporate action was announced. The filing is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
